tools.name: lookup_vendor_hipaa
tools.description: Check whether an AI tool or practice software vendor offers a HIPAA business associate agreement (BAA), plan by plan where known, with the vendor's own source and the date ZYNAGI checked it. Covers ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Zoom, Google Drive and 400+ dental and healthcare vendors. Input is

tools.name: check_review_reply
tools.description: Scan a draft reply to a Google, Yelp or Facebook review for phrases that could disclose patient information or confirm someone is a patient. Input is the public reply text only; never include private patient details.

tools.name: get_safe_review_reply
tools.description: Get a ready-to-post, HIPAA-safe reply template for an online review, by situation.

tools.name: get_free_template
tools.description: Get a link to a free ZYNAGI HIPAA form, template, checklist or poster for dental and medical offices. Leave name empty to list them all.

tools.name: hipaa_deadlines
tools.description: Look up HIPAA deadlines for records requests, breach notification, amendments, accountings of disclosures, record retention and training, plus what changes under the new HIPAA Privacy Rule on July 19, 2027 (privacy_rule_2027). Omit topic to list all.

tools.name: hipaa_compliance_checklist
tools.description: Get the HIPAA compliance checklist for small dental and medical practices, whole or by section, to work through with the user.

tools.name: check_vendor_list
tools.description: Check every AI tool and software vendor a practice uses in one go. Returns each one's BAA status with sources, grouped by what needs action first. Input is a list of tool or vendor names only (up to 40), never patient information.

tools.name: find_baa_alternative
tools.description: Find vendors in the same category as a given tool (or in a named category) that sign a HIPAA BAA, best first, with sources. Use when a tool has no BAA or the user wants options.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_review_reply, get_safe_review_reply, hipaa_deadlines · Private data: check_review_reply, hipaa_deadlines · Public sink: get_safe_review_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_review_reply, get_safe_review_reply, hipaa_deadlines · Private data: check_review_reply, hipaa_deadlines · Public sink: get_safe_review_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
